rag.text:
Test: TC-4789 — Global - Workload Plans - Bulk assignment in Workload plans tab
Priority: Medium | Status: In Review | Type: Manual
Folder: /BP/TS-39 Global - Workload plans
Labels: be-enterprise

Steps:
1. Navigate to Administration -> Resources -> Workload plans tab
   Expected: Workload plans tab is displayed



Following buttons are displayed in the right corner of this tab:

Synchronize with Tempo, Assign Individuals and Add new plan
2. Click on Assign Individuals
   Expected: 'Assign individuals to workload plan' modal window is displayed with following select buttons:

Workload plan (placeholder: Select workload)

Efficiency 1 set as default

Start date (End date will be adjusted automatically)

Users (placeholder: Select user)
3. Select workloadPlanName, set startDate
   Data: workloadPlanName: TC-4789

startDate: 01/Sep/24
   Expected: Workload plan T-4789 is selected

Start date is set to 01/Sep/24
4. Click on users selector and type userName
   Data: userName: TC-4789
   Expected: Following users appeared in selector:

TC-4789A

TC-4789B

TC-4789C
5. Select userName1 and userName2 and click assign
   Data: userName1: TC-4789A

userName2: TC-4789B
   Expected: Modal window is closed
6. Click on workloadPlanName
   Data: workloadPlanName: TC-4789
   Expected: Details of workload plan TC-4789 are displayed
7. Click on ‘Assigned resources’ button
   Expected: List of assigned resources is displayed:

TC-4789A with efficiency 1 and startDate 01/Sep/24

TC-4789B with efficiency 1 and startDate 01/Sep/24
